items.quote: Not what to say... but how to think is important.
items.statement: When engaging with clients, focus on how to think rather than just what to say.

items.quote: when you are with the client, you should lead, not react to what they are saying.
items.statement: Lead the conversation instead of merely reacting to clients' statements.

items.quote: I can certainly advise you on what to say in response to any client objection.

items.quote: Start by asking yourself: "What is the next step in my sales process with this client?"
items.statement: Ask yourself what the next step is in your sales process with the client.
